rules.name: balance_consistency
rules.description: Current balance should not exceed original balance (except for fees/capitalized interest)

rules.name: date_validity_origination_before_reporting
rules.description: Origination month must be before or equal to reporting month

rules.name: loan_age_non_negative
rules.description: Loan age in months must be non-negative

rules.name: delinquency_status_consistency
rules.description: Days past due must be consistent with current_status
rules.check: (current_status == 'Current' and days_past_due == 0) or (current_status in ['30-59 DPD', '60-89 DPD', '90+ DPD'] and days_past_due > 0)

rules.name: closed_prepaid_logic
rules.description: If loan is closed/prepaid, current_balance should be 0 or near 0
rules.check: (current_status in ['Prepaid', 'Closed', 'Defaulted'] and current_balance <= original_balance * 0.05) or (current_status not in ['Prepaid', 'Closed', 'Defaulted'])

rules.name: document_status_gaps
rules.description: Document status should not be missing for active loans

rules.name: interest_rate_bounds
rules.description: Interest rate should be within reasonable bounds (0-30%)

rules.name: credit_score_band_valid
rules.description: Credit score band must be one of the valid categories

rules.name: ltv_band_valid
rules.description: LTV band must be one of the valid categories

rules.name: dti_band_valid
rules.description: DTI band must be one of the valid categories

rules.name: document_status_valid
rules.description: Document status must be one of the valid categories

rules.name: prepayment_default_mutual_exclusive
rules.description: A loan cannot be both prepaid and defaulted in the same month

rules.name: current_balance_positive
rules.description: Current balance must be non-negative and less than or equal to original balance
